name: harness-scope
description: Turn global skills, rules, agents and tools on or off per repo with named profiles. Add a one-line .claude/harness-scope.json to a repo; /harness-scope shows what is off

configDir.title: Claude Code configuration directory
configDir.description: Where your profiles live (<this>/harness-scope/profiles/). Leave empty: it is read off where the plugin is installed. Set it when you load the plugin with --plugin-dir.
